name: intake
description: Intake: the owner's request kept word for word with sentence ids, and the pathway, stack and lane it proposes from bands (docs/design/intake.md).

CLAIM-SOURCE.fix: name the requests the intent comes from (request: [Q-<n>]) and give each goal line, story and requirement statement a source in brackets: a request sentence [Q-<n>.<k>], an answered question [Q<k>], an assumption [A<k>] listed under # Assumptions, or a fact [F-<n>] (docs: Intake)

REQUEST-COVERAGE.fix: cite each sentence of the request where the intent or a requirement answers it, or under # Out of scope with the reason (docs: Intake)

commands.name: intake
commands.does: keep the owner's request word for word as requests/Q-<n>, and propose its pathway, stack and lane

messages.intakeUsage: usage: aidlc intake "<the owner's words>" or --file <path>; then aidlc intake Q-<n> --ambiguity|--risk|--assumptions <band>:<sentence ids>
messages.intakeEmpty: the request holds no sentence: pass the owner's words as they wrote them
messages.intakeBand: {{factor}} {{value}}: write <band>:<ids>, a band of {{bands}} and the request's sentence ids
messages.intakeNoIds: {{factor}} {{band}} cites no sentence: a medium or high band names the sentences it rests on
messages.intakeRiskFloor: risk {{band}} is below what the request's words show ({{floor}}): risk is raised, never lowered
messages.intakeTell: tell the owner in two or three plain sentences what kind of change this is and how much process it needs, then this proposal; they confirm or change it, and the intent records request: {{id}}, pathway and lane
messages.intakeVerification: a test level that runs: {{tests}}; CI: {{ci}}
messages.claimNoRequest: {{unit}} names no request: keep the owner's words with aidlc intake and record request: [Q-<n>]
messages.claimNoSuchRequest: {{unit}} names {{ref}}, which is no request in {{dir}}
messages.claimSentence: {{unit}} cites {{ref}}, which is no sentence of its requests ({{requests}})
messages.claimQuestion: {{unit}} cites {{ref}}, which is no answered question of {{intent}}
messages.claimAssumption: {{unit}} cites {{ref}}, which {{intent}} does not list under # Assumptions
messages.claimFact: {{unit}} cites {{ref}}, which is no platform fact
